sources.title: Asia Weekly · 20th-Century 100 Best Chinese Fictions (1999) — result publication
sources.evidence_notes: All 100 positions in the June 1999 result selected by a 14-member transregional jury from a shortlist of more than 500 Chinese-language works.
sources.limitations: The original Asia Weekly page is no longer directly available. The exact Chinese ordering comes from a contemporaneous-style transcription and was cross-checked against a separate English-language transcription. The source defines fiction broadly and includes story collections and multi-volume works.
